evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To address this gap, we introduce WildSEEK, a manually annotated dataset of 3k information-seeking queries from real user interactions, and an evaluation framework for LLM-generated responses.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: By providing methods to monitor the reliability, safety, and fairness of LLM behavior, our dataset and evaluation framework offer an empirical foundation for the broader question of how these systems should behave as they take on a growing role in information access.
